functionalRequirement: Customers shall be able to search for new products in the database by entering item names, and upon successful search, view detailed product information.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must support search functionality for 100% of the products listed in the database, ensuring that all products are searchable by item name.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to search for products by name, necessitating complete coverage of the product database.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must return accurate and complete product information for 99.9% of search queries, matching the entered item name exactly or through relevant synonyms.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies the need for correct and detailed product information post-search.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must return search results within 2 seconds for 95% of queries, regardless of the number of products in the database.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves real-time search functionality, requiring quick response times for user satisfaction.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Resource Utilization: The system must use no more than 100 MB of memory to process a search query and display product information.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Efficient resource use is critical for scalability, given the FR’s focus on searching a potentially large product database.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operability: The search interface must allow users to input item names with auto-suggest functionality, displaying suggestions within 500 milliseconds of typing.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires interaction with the search functionality, which should be easy to operate for users.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Error Protection: The system must provide clear error messages and suggestions for correction if a search query yields no results, helping users refine their search.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves user interaction with the system, necessitating support to minimize user errors during searches.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The system must be available to perform product searches and display product information for 99.9% of the operational time.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR assumes continuous access to the product database, necessitating high availability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: The system must encrypt all search queries and product information during transmission using TLS 1.3.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves accessing product information, which may contain sensitive data requiring protection.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Modifiability: The system must allow for the addition or modification of product search algorithms without affecting the overall system performance, with changes deployable within 1 hour.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies the need for ongoing updates to the product database and search functionality.

functionalRequirement: The system shall allow users to search for suggested doctors for consultation based on their symptoms or predicted diseases.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must support search functionality for 100% of the doctors listed in the database, ensuring that all doctors are searchable by symptoms or predicted diseases.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to search for doctors based on user input, necessitating complete coverage of the doctor database.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must return accurate and relevant doctor suggestions for 99% of search queries, matching the entered symptoms or predicted diseases.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies the need for correct and relevant doctor suggestions post-search.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must return search results within 3 seconds for 95% of queries, regardless of the number of doctors in the database.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves real-time search functionality, requiring quick response times for user satisfaction.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Resource Utilization: The system must use no more than 150 MB of memory to process a search query and display doctor suggestions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Efficient resource use is critical for scalability, given the FR’s focus on searching a potentially large doctor database.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operability: The search interface must allow users to input symptoms or predicted diseases with auto-suggest functionality, displaying suggestions within 500 milliseconds of typing.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires interaction with the search functionality, which should be easy to operate for users.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Error Protection: The system must provide clear error messages and suggestions for correction if a search query yields no results, helping users refine their search.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves user interaction with the system, necessitating support to minimize user errors during searches.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The system must be available to perform doctor searches and display suggestions for 99.9% of the operational time.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR assumes continuous access to the doctor database, necessitating high availability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: The system must encrypt all search queries and doctor information during transmission using TLS 1.3.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves accessing sensitive health-related information, requiring protection.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Modifiability: The system must allow for the addition or modification of doctor search algorithms without affecting the overall system performance, with changes deployable within 1 hour.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies the need for ongoing updates to the doctor database and search functionality.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operational Constraint: The system must ensure that doctor suggestions are based on verified medical data and comply with healthcare regulations.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves health-related services, necessitating adherence to safety standards and regulations.
